datasheet_identity.title: BAT54 THRU BAT54S Surface Mount Schottky Barrier Rectifier

extraction_notes: BAT54A is the BAT54A:KL2 SOT-23 common-anode dual-diode ordering variant shown in the p. 1 function diagram: pin 3 is the common anode and pins 1 and 2 are the two cathodes; preserve diode polarity as pin 3 to pin 1 and pin 3 to pin 2.

The electrical-characteristics table and typical curves are shared by the BAT54 through BAT54S family; the extracted curves preserve their forward/reverse semantics, temperature traces, the pulsed condition shown for the reverse curves, and the capacitance frequency bias.

The p. 2 Fig. 1 forward curves are typical instantaneous forward current versus forward voltage at Ta = 25 degC and Ta = 100 degC; the p. 2 Fig. 2 reverse curves are typical pulsed reverse current versus reverse voltage at Ta = 25 degC and Ta = 100 degC.
The p. 2 Fig. 3 capacitance curve is typical capacitance between terminals versus reverse voltage at Ta = 25 degC and f = 1 MHz.
Curve points were digitized from the actual plotted traces only. No interpolated or catalog-derived points were added.
All tabulated electrical-characteristics entries are maximum limits, not typical values. Tabulated units were converted to SI: mV to V, microampere to A, pF to F, and ns to s.
The p. 1 maximum ratings list VRRM = 30 V, VDC = 30 V, and IF(AV) = 0.2 A at Ta = 25 degC; these are ratings and were not treated as breakdown-voltage or typical-curve points.
No breakdown-voltage electrical characteristic is published; the reverse-voltage rating is not a breakdown measurement.
